headline: On October 13, 1976: First Ebola Virus Electron Micrograph Taken
captionCards: First Ebola virus image captured by Dr. F. A. Murphy
Electron microscopy remains essential in modern virology
instagramCaption:
Dr. F. A. Murphy captures the first Ebola virus image.\nDr. F. A. Murphy at the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention took the first electron micrograph of an Ebola virus in 1976. This groundbreaking image, magnified thousands of times, revealed the virus's structure. The use of electron microscopy was crucial in understanding this deadly pathogen. Today, this technology continues to be vital in virology research. What other viruses do you think were discovered using electron microscopy?
